candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business Intel Corporation (INTC) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Intel designs and manufactures semiconductors using an integrated device manufacturing model, including client and data-center processors, and is developing foundry services for external customers. Principal operations: Intel Corporation. Reported segments include: Client Computing (42% of revenue); Data Center & AI (28% of revenue); Intel Foundry (15% of revenue); Other (15% of revenue). Our semiconductor business model is idm. We design and manufacture semiconductors in captive fabrication facilities and also describe foundry services initiatives.
